title: Translation Asymmetry in LLMs as a Data Augmentation Factor: A Case Study for 6 Romansh Language Varieties
abstract: arXiv:2603.25489v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent strategies for low-resource machine translation rely on LLMs to generate synthetic data based on text in higher-resource languages. We revisit this idea for Romansh, a language with 6 distinct varieties. LLMs tend to confuse these varieties when translating into Romansh, but they are quite good at translating out of Romansh into a high-resource language such as German. Due to this asymmetry, the direction of data augmentation is a crucial choice. We find that contrary to recent strategies, creating synthetic translations into the higher-resource language is the superior approach, and only this approach allows us to surpass a Gemini 3 Pro baseline on German-Romansh translation (+23 BLEU over Gemini in the lowest-resource variety). A human evaluation confirms that our experiments yield the first model that generates fluent translations in the individual Romansh varieties.

translated_title: 大型语言模型中的翻译不对称性作为数据增强因素：以6种罗曼什语变体为例的研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.25489v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：近期针对低资源机器翻译的策略依赖于大型语言模型（LLMs）基于高资源语言文本生成合成数据。我们重新审视了这一思路，针对罗曼什语（一种具有6种不同变体的语言）进行研究。LLMs在将其他语言翻译成罗曼什语时容易混淆这些变体，但在将罗曼什语翻译成高资源语言（如德语）时表现相当出色。由于这种不对称性，数据增强的方向成为一个关键选择。我们发现，与近期策略相反，将合成翻译生成到高资源语言中是更优的方法，并且只有这种方法能让我们在德语-罗曼什语翻译中超越Gemini 3 Pro基线（在资源最少的变体上比Gemini高出+23 BLEU分数）。人工评估证实，我们的实验产生了首个能在各个罗曼什语变体中生成流畅翻译的模型。
tldr: 该论文发现，在低资源语言（如罗曼什语）的机器翻译中，利用LLM的翻译不对称性，将数据增强方向从生成目标语言改为生成高资源语言，能显著提升性能并首次实现各变体的流畅翻译。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that leveraging translation asymmetry in LLMs for low-resource language (e.g., Romansh) machine translation, by reversing data augmentation to generate high-resource language text, significantly improves performance and achieves fluent translations across varieties for the first time.
